demo_provider.ui_visibility: A persistent banner 'OFFLINE DEMO IDENTITY - not Clerk authentication' on every product page; GET /product/v1/system reports demo_mode=true.

authorization.rule: a user may access only their own
authorization.research_pages: federation overview, clients, models registry and research pages are globally readable to any authenticated identity (Clerk or explicit demo); runs are owner-scoped

ml_independence.statement: Authentication controls only user identity, session ownership and device ownership. It MUST NOT control model, threshold, calibration, federated algorithm, candidate selection or scientific identity.

clerk_constraints.CLERK_SECRET_KEY: server-side only; never in frontend code
clerk_constraints.frontend_integration_phase: CAP-005 inside the existing SvelteKit app (a Svelte-compatible Clerk integration, not Next.js)
